Added an effect that resyncs the location-derived field when `locationId` changes on a fresh (non-edit, non-supply-order) form — setting `origin` for internal deliveries and `destination` otherwise: [DeliveryOrderForm.tsx](src/pages/Facility/services/inventory/externalSupply/deliveryOrder/DeliveryOrderForm.tsx#L206-L211)

The remaining diagnostics in that file are pre-existing and unrelated to this change.
